notes.title: Update 0.6.5: Lower Bridges, Bust Banks, and Save Mom!
notes.content:
Hello again Mom Savers!


This update brings our most complex level yet, a radiated town with multiple paths, each packed with unique themes and challenges that will even make Mom shiver as she drives through.


🔥Highlights
New Level: Our biggest and most complex so far, with branching routes and fresh mechanics.

New objective: Lower the bridge. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/0d01cfdcf74cf55bf501fbf813b4f143ba1e3e1a.jpg"]The motorhome can’t cross until players figure out how to lower the bridge.

New objective: Destroy radiation pumps[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/b0bb00b184ed5db0874488d7f97ecad2692ab020.jpg"]Some nasty polluted water is being pumped into the road, mom refuses to get the motorhome dirty. Destroy source of pollution to continue your journey.

New objective: Destroy the bank.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/5e5d0c9800cf6005b41253d885e44408618bfff8.jpg"]Mom's needs to make a "withdraw" from the bank, she says is her retirement money. She refuses to continue until her kids get the money, one way or another.

New point of interest: Self storage warehouse. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f2294493349430e702fe417130ee5b554abeb96c.jpg"]Abandoned units may hold loot… or an unpleasant surprise.


Besides the highlights, these are the changes included in this release


🆕Added
Added new component to create rope like behavior, used for cables and when lowering the bridge

Added VFX for green goo and radiated splat.

Added buoyancy effect for objects in water.

Added a Force Continue button on the game over flow so the server does not have to wait for a client

Added new ground textures, used mainly for the new level

Added custom laser particles for Bongo's weapon.

Added object pool for projectiles. This should help with performance


⚙️Changes
Changed level 04 to have many more enemies, making this a real rush level!

Enemies no longer spawn after level is completed.

Changes to pickable resource graphics.

Improved view transitions when going to and from the settings view to be faster and more snappy.

Changed meta map scale to fit all the levels in the region.

Changed ghost image when placing sentries or interactable (fuel barrels, scrap) to make them more noticeable.

Tweaked bullet trails.

Many changes to the amount of data we send over the network for enemies to reduce network lag.

Upgraded Unity version.

Changed volume probes in all levels, they where baking too much information and producing minimal visuals.

Removed unused packages and URP features

Meta Map light is now baked.

🔧 Fixes
Fixed portraits not animating

Fixed issue where players will remain laying down after revive.

Fixed muzzle flash not showing for player weapons.

Fixed smoke in missile silo.

Fixed storage container not updating in the clients.

Fixed road selector effect not showing properly.

Fixed lens distortion main menu.

Fixed some small environment objects having very tiny colliders.

Fixed enemy pathfinding not working when some obstacles were destroyed.



That’s it for this week’s release! We hope this new level feels different, offers higher replayability, and surprises you with fresh mechanics to make saving Mom even more challenging.



Until next time, for now some extra images for this update:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/ca6af049a0f54a79f0e15c5cdcb39b6c517ab369.jpg"]Mom's 4th favorite diner

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/da6fe264c15633c5af8451ee5f4661dbc365d0bc.jpg"]They were normal bulls, until someone feed them...


Help save Mom by wishlisting today, she promises cookies if you do!*
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470800/Save_Mom/"][/dynamiclink] *Unfortunately cookies are not included with the purchase of the game :(

notes.title: Update 0.6.4: Settings included
notes.content:
Greetings from Mom!


First of all, a big thanks to everyone who has played Save Mom! Your feedback has been super valuable and helps us keep improving the game.

This update introduces a basic Settings Menu, so you can tweak graphics options and get smoother performance on different hardware.


The Highlights
NEW Main Menu with settings and credits views.

Settings to configure several graphics options!

Several improvements to materials, decals and network parameters to reduce lag



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/abba7aea411e7a4754bdd875fbed3fd522bc4b6b.png"]


🆕Added
New street decals to show intersections and road signs

Added new settings menu with transitions to Credits and Settings view

Added several configurable options for graphics


⚙️Changes
Tweaks to enemies speed making the smaller run faster than the small ones

Changed range of light produced by projectiles

Tweaked lighting settings for several objects, this should help with performance


🔧 Fixes
Fixed enemies running diagonally toward targets

Fixed player death animation not playing

Fixed ragdoll bugs that caused enemies to clip through the floor or get dragged by players

Fixed players sliding when dead

Fixed some enemy animations not playing properly

This is still just the beginning, more network optimizations are on the way to make gameplay even smoother. We also plan to add the Settings Menu to the pause screen, so you can change options mid-game in a future update.



We’ve also been working hard on new levels and visuals, which we cannot wait to show soon!
Stay tuned, and keep saving Mom!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f9494d1b37969eedb243b0ef11f6d45b0302214d.png"]

notes.title: Update 0.6.0: The Motorhome May Stop, But You Don’t
notes.content:
Greetings Mom Savers


We’ve got a big update packed with new features, improvements, and polish! Thanks to your feedback and playtesting, we’re shaping Save Mom into a richer, more fun experience. This version brings in fresh content, new ways to play, and loads of fixes.

Let’s dive into what’s new!


HighlightsNew level + new game mode
Introducing a fresh twist: the motorhome breaks down, and it’s up to you to defend Mom while it gets repaired. Build defenses, hold your ground, and watch your flanks, enemies can come from unexpected places in this dynamic new map.
Drone Upgrade
A new drone now hovers around Mom’s motorhome, scouting enemies and assisting in defense. It’s fast, deadly, and smart!
Flare Launcher Upgrade
Auto-deploys flares when enemies get too close to Mom, distracting them in the heat of battle. Light up the night, stay alive!
Level music is back!
Defending Mom just got more immersive. We’ve added music to levels to enhance the atmosphere and pacing, with plans to expand this with more variety in future updates!


⚙️ Gameplay & UX Improvements
Clients can now reconnect to a running session

Smoother loading screen transitions for joining players

Building menu now closes automatically after placing a building

You can now place pickables and close signs with the E key

Added camera shake and sound effects when placing sentries

Sentries now appear on the radar and have improved build/death animations

Updated UI for upgrade selection and game over screens

Improved level selection clarity on the meta map (available, unavailable, completed)

Character selection backgrounds now match your player color

Changed “Roll” to “Dash” in the pause menu


🔧 Fixes & Tweaks
Fixed destroyed obstacles still blocking enemy movement

Fixed leftover colliders from destroyed obstacles

Improved shooting transitions for Derek and SueAnn

Fixed missile sentry not disappearing when recycled

Fixed end horde mode spawning only one wave

Fixed caravan lights staying on during the day

Fixed fuel pump interaction and abrupt coin sound ending

Fixed player HP bar displaying decimals

Balanced flare brightness and fuel collection values

Updated visuals for explosions, intersections, and props

Fixed level numbers not updating on the meta map

General lighting, terrain, and navigation fixes



That’s all for now! As always, we love hearing your thoughts. Your feedback helps us shape Save Mom into something even better. We’ve also been watching your streams and videos, and they’ve been both inspiring and incredibly helpful. Seeing how you play gives us new perspectives and ideas we hadn’t considered.

Keep sharing your experiences, and keep protecting Mom. We’ll be watching (in a good way!)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45518950/f9494d1b37969eedb243b0ef11f6d45b0302214d.png"]

notes.title: Save Mom Update: Visible Mom, Upgrade Overhaul & Gold Economy!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We’re back with a brand new update for Save Mom, and this one adds a lot more personality, polish, and strategy.


Mom Is Now Visible!
Mom will now physically leave the caravan and walk to nearby points of interest, whether she's fixing her nails or taking a bathroom break in the middle of a desolate wasteland. This change brings her more to life and present as players move through the levels.


Overhauled Caravan Upgrade System
We’ve revamped the upgrade screen! Gone is the placeholder UI, now you’ll find clearer upgrade paths, better visuals, and a much more informative and intuitive way to invest in your caravan.


New Resource: Gold 
Gold is now used to purchase upgrades. You’ll earn it after finishing levels, and leftover scrap is automatically converted into gold, making sentry refunds and resource spending far more strategic.

These systems will continue to evolve, but this is a major first step toward making caravan progression more meaningful.


Full Changelog

New Features:


 New upgrade UI with better layout and feedback


 Added gold as an upgrade currency


 Scrap now converts to gold after each level using a ratio


 Mom now walks to points of interest during stops


 Upgrade parts now feature unique flavor text


 Rotation added to throwable objects


 Delay added when building sentries (especially helpful in multiplayer)


 Separate footstep system for Mom/NPCs


 Added upgrade sprites for missing parts (top turret, side turrets, etc)


 New objective type: Timed objectives. Used when mom is crazy doing something and players need to protect her for a set amount of time


 Character badge for vote indicators. Now is clearer to see what other players want for upgrades


 New scrap thumbnail sprite


 Now some objectives can be dismissed after completing them.



Tweaks & Improvements:


 Rebalanced upgrade prices and effects


 Flare visuals and VFX improvements


 New atmospheric level music


 Terrain-based footstep system


 Faster game over animation


 Game over screen now has more space for player cards


 Level stop points now use the new mom interaction system



Bug Fixes:


 Flare collision issues fixed


 Bullet decals missing from some buildings now appear


 Explosion VFX now triggers correctly when destroying obstacles


 Fixed misaligned effect areas for oil/radiation pools


 Fixed side turret rate of fire


 Fixed Bongo’s turret rotation sync


 Decal layering fix in level 2


 Fixed level blockers to prevent out-of-bounds exploits


 Improved multiplayer object spawning reliability


 Fixed dirt road decal showing over resources


 Improved loading screen readability (dynamic text color!)


 Fixed caravan movement stuttering, specially when player and the caravan moved at the same time



We’re super excited to hear your thoughts. Jump in, test the new systems, and let us know what you think!

Thanks for playing Save Mom!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470800/Save_Mom/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Level revamp and more! (0.5.5)
notes.content:
Hello again!

For this playtest update, we focused on making more interesting and challenging levels that are also more visually appealing.

To achieve that, we have redone the road navigation system, which now supports a new feature: branching paths. This feature means that at certain milestones, players choose which direction the caravan should take, and each path has its own challenges and theme to make the level feel different. As a playtest version, we have only introduced this to one level, but we have experimented with the road navigation in other levels as well.

We have made night levels scarier and more challenging by exploring a new game mode where Mom's vehicle will not stop until it reaches the final destination. Can you keep up with her and keep her safe?

Lighting has also improved: we changed our workflow to use baked lighting, which should enhance performance and allow for more immersive, detailed light and shadows.

Finally, we designed and added new upgrades for the Campervan that will make Mom a formidable tank when fully upgraded! There are many more upgrades that we have designed and would love to make available in a later release.

That’s the highlights, here are the high-level patch notes:


 Added new levels, each with its own special theme and mechanics.
 Added new road system that allows for branching paths and more organic vehicle movement.
 Added diagonal animations to the playable characters.
 Added turret upgrade. This replaces the placeholder sentry but has more power and visual upgrades.
 Added side turret upgrade. This can be placed in front of the vehicle and shoots to the sides at enemies close to Mom.
 Added over 30 new assets for the new levels (trucks, containers, new pueblo houses, construction props, signs, vehicles, decals, points of interest) and many more.
 Added cinematic camera panning when entering a level.
 Changed how enemies spawn; now they should not spawn so close to players.
 Changed how points of interest spawn interactable (fuel barrels and scrap boxes), now more predictable and avoiding unreachable areas.
 Changed players’ physics material to improve collisions with the environment.
 Fixed sentries not shooting enemies that were too close.
 Fixed pathfinding where enemies could get stuck on small corners.
 Fixed missing radiation map for enemies; only some were radiating at night.
 Fixed issue with loading screen text being visible when the loading screen was fading out.
 Fixed cactus pivots spawning in the middle of the road.


We want to keep the change list short and focus on relevant and visible points, but there are MANY more changes, tweaks, balancing, fixes, internal tools improvements, and more that we have been working on!

Our focus is to create fun and challenging levels with meaningful progression. There is still much more to do, but we hope this update is a step closer to achieving that!

We would appreciate any feedback you can provide!

That’s all for now! Greetings from Mom!

notes.title: Campervan Upgrades are here! (0.4.13)
notes.content:
Big update today! 

This new version adds several new levels and introduces the very first version of our RV upgrade system. This marks an important milestone for us. You can now improve your RV as you progress through the game 🚐 


Detail changelog:

 Added system that allows to upgrade the Campervan. It is quite flexible and allows for custom parts to be installed that can do all sorts of things!
 Now is possible to recycle buildable to get 50% of their cost.
 Each playable character now has its own utility. Derek has flares and SueAnn has grenades.
 After finishing a level the character selection view remembers the previous selection and skips the character and ability selection views.
 Added 8 new levels!
 Added new enemy! A BIG mutated enemy that is slow but has a lot of HP. 
 Added rotation cursor when placing buildables, to indicate that they can be rotated with the scroll wheel.
 Added particles when destroying obstacles.
 Added speed modifier that is used in Oil pools that can slow down players when stepping into them.
 Added scrap when destroying obstacles.
 Added level selector images to add flavor to selecting levels.
 Added new controller to the campervan in the meta map! It should be easier to drive now with simpler controls!
 Added custom light and volume settings per level. This allow us to have some levels be at night!
 Changed Game Over screen to have a different color when the level was won vs when the level was lost.
 Changes to the player HUD, reducing its size and making it more clean.
 Changed character portrait to be on the bottom of the HUD.
 Changed Keyboard shortcuts for abilities.
 Changed drop object button. Instead of dropping/placing picked objects with E the left mouse button is used.
 Changed objectives view to have different visuals and animations.
 Changed health bars to include numbers, this makes it easy to see when upgrades are applied.
 Changed sentries HP to be more resistant to damage.
 Changed the time anvil and pianos remain on screen before disappearing.
 Changed grenade explosion, now with better visuals that show in the ground the effect of the explosion.
 Changed how the object interaction UI shows which button needs to be pressed. This allows the button to changed based on the interactable state.
 Changed grenade sprite visuals to be consistent in all places.
 Changed prices of sentries to be more valuable, specially since now they can be recycled.
 Changed flare to add visual effect that indicates that is attracting enemies.
 Changed scrap yard to now give scrap instead of armor parts.
 Changed mouse traps to deal more damage and be bigger! Now they look and are dangerous.
 Changed MissileSentry making it more powerful with more damage and radius.
 Changed several sound effects to be more passive and reduce volume of very prominent sounds.
 Changed the player upgrade plus button to have a border and be more prominent.
 Fixes to the character selection view that made views disappear when scrolling too fast through them.
 Fixed issue with full screen images not having the correct compression, thus creating artifacts on the images.
 Fixed issues with the radial progress bar not resetting its state after filling.
 Fixed pathfinding problems with some props on the map. Now enemies should avoid them.
 Fixed issue where the SaveMom app was reported as open on steam even after closing it.
 Fixed issue where level objectives were shown in the GameOver view.
 Fixed Crashed UFO collider.
 Removed walls as buildables. In their current state they where hard to place and they were not as critical as the sentries.
 Removed move interactable from the RV.
 Removed unused third party packages.
 Enabled Render Graph pipeline, this should improve performance in cases where graphics were the bottleneck.


There were other internal changes that mom's campervan needed under the hood for the team to be able to work more efficient!

notes.title: Playtest 0.4.7
notes.content:
Adding more of the amazing feedback!

We’re continuing to build on the great feedback we’ve received, making Save Mom more intuitive, clearer, and just overall better to play.

This patch brings important changes to how mechanics are introduced and how the game communicates key elements. It’s a step forward, but not the final destination—we’re committed to refining the experience even further in future updates.

The list of changes for this patch:


 Added new loading screen!
 Added controls hints on the pause menu.
 Added particle effects for collecting scrap.
 Added damage state in road obstacles to visualized how damaged their are.
 Added fade effect to enemies in the radar. Now they fade when died instead of instantly disappearing.
 Changed sign post to allow closing with the ESC key.
 Changed logic of bullet dispersion to make Shotgun bullets more balanced.
 Changed bank graphics to fit better in the screen.
 Changed anvil visuals to avoid issues with ACME trade mark.
 Changed loading screen to be more pleasing
 Changed visuals for the blood splat of enemies.
 Changed visuals for tooltips on interactable.
 Changed Mom speech bubble to appear immediately.
 Changed collectibles collect range, now it should be easier to collect them all!.
 Changed Anvil to no longer be a target for enemies.
 Changed wave spawn system, prevents enemies from spawning from the other side of the map.
 Changed spawn position of interactables to be closer to the point of interest.
 Changed upgrade screen to have a plus sign instead of a checkmark
 Fixes for UI text not being readable or too small.
 Fixed some UI overlapping text (I'm talking to you countdown!)
 Fixed clipping planes on the second level.
 Fixed missing colliders for radiation barrels in second level.
 Fixed issue with characters not moving while a controller was plugged.
 Improved enemy pathfinding on waves to prevent them from coming in a single line.
 Removed enemies around POI to allow players to read and familiarize with the interactables.


That is by no means all the feedback changes! We still have many other things to adapt and improve!



Alright, that’s enough reading. Go outside… and, you know, survive. – Mom

notes.title: Playtest 0.4.6
notes.content:
Playtest feedback. Round 1. Fight!

Thanks all for the amazing playtest feedback on the first day, We are extremely grateful and we have been able to see the game with fresh eyes and ideas.

We read all the feedback and comments and we are working hard to analyze and prioritize the issues.
This first patch introduces some small but hopefully welcome changes, being focus mainly on balancing


 Reduce amount of enemies per wave to be more manageable for single player session.
 Reduced initial population of enemies.
 Reduced HP of the container obstacle.
 Increased damage of grenade
 Removed IP connection, dialog when creating a session. The steam connection also works for single player and it streamlines the session creation.
 Enemy waves no longer start immediately when the "enemy wave incoming" alert pops up. This gives players enough time to prepare for incoming attacks.
 Added poison damage to the radiation puddles. Now stepping on them will cause damage over time ☢ 
 Simplify Gas Station mechanic to automatically fill fuel barrel instead of manually setting it to pump. This was not very clear and did not add much value.
 Improved visuals for sign post that notify how to use points of interest.
 RV health bar now shakes when the RV takes damage 
 RV armor upgrades are no longer removable. There was very little point on removing them anyway.
 Added movement instruction UI in the level selection to help communicate that the RV can move.
 Fixed issue that prevented entering the RV when armor upgrades were applied.
 Fixed issue where sounds where playing on the Game Over screen.
 Fixed issue where player name were not showing properly on the game over screen.
 Fixed clipping issue on the level selection.


This is just the beginning!

Save Mom!
